name: Hero Worship (d20pfsrd)
body:
You admire an NPC as a hero to respect and attempt to model your life after.

You gain one of the following benefits depending on the NPC chosen (consult your GM for details).

A +2 bonus on concentration checks.

A +1 bonus to your AC against attacks of opportunity.
